violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM present has expired certification.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A follow up will be conducted to ensure that CFM certifications have been renewed.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Stuffing (56F), meatball (52F), garlic butter (53F), potato soup (50F), and chili (50F) observed in 1 Dr UR unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Discarded

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1 Dr UR observed at 51F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. TCS foods removed from unit.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed ventless fryer for potato fries installed in establishment without review or approval.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: Ventless fryer. EHS will provide instructions to management to submit amendment and building application.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. PIC stated that a manager is supposed to bring some later today.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a BLEACH test kit for the dish machine.
